code-dev-toolkit 1.0.0

- Initial release of the professional-grade, enterprise-focused code development toolkit.
- Adds advanced workflow features: multi-task orchestration, dependency management, and team coding standards.
- Integrates quality gates (test coverage, lint/type checks, security), automated code review, and delivery auditing.
- Provides built-in CI/CD pipeline support and multi-environment release management.
- Fully compatible and upgradeable from the free edition; includes audit logs and priority technical support.
